DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約についてのお問い合わせですね。お困りの点を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about an appointment. Please tell me what the problem is.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母の受診に付き添う予定でしたが、その日は仕事を休めなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 付き添いの日に仕事を休めなくなったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going to accompany my mother to her medical appointment, but I can no longer take that day off work.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you can no longer take time off work on the day you were to accompany someone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お母様の予約票をご用意いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you have your mother's appointment slip ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手元にあります。本人の代わりに、変更の相談だけできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の代わりに予約変更を相談できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have it here. Can I just discuss changing the appointment on her behalf?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can discuss changing the appointment on the patient's behalf. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず担当窓口で相談できる範囲を確認します。希望の曜日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, we'll check with the responsible desk what you can discuss. Is there a day of the week you would prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: できれば水曜日ですが、診察を延ばしてよいかも先生に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水曜日を希望し受診を延ばす判断も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Wednesday, if possible, but I also want to ask the doctor whether it is all right to postpone her visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you prefer Wednesday and also want to check whether postponing the visit is appropriate. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受診時期の判断は私からはできません。その希望も担当者へ伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can't judge when she should be seen. Let's pass that request on to the staff member too.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、今の予約は取り消さずに、先に相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現予約を消さずに相談を先行できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then can we discuss it first without canceling her current appointment?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can discuss this first while keeping the existing appointment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約を残したまま相談したいとのことですね。その点も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You'd like to discuss it while keeping the appointment. I'll check that as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母にも状況を話し、予約票をそろえて担当窓口に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人と話し予約票を用意して担当者へ相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the situation to my mother too, get the appointment slip ready, and consult the responsible desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will talk with the patient, prepare the appointment slip, and consult the responsible staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 変更が決まるまでは元の予定も控えておいてください。お母様と確認のうえ、またご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please also keep a note of the original schedule until a change is decided. Check with your mother and contact us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの袋をお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be using this bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この袋を使いますが、野菜が少し濡れているので、パンとは分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れた野菜とパンを別々にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll use this bag, but the vegetables are a little wet, so I'd like to keep them separate from the bread.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want the wet vegetables and bread kept separate. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: パンは袋の上に入れましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Shall I put the bread at the top of the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい布の袋も持っています。パンはそちらに入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参した小さな布袋へパンを入れるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I also brought a small cloth bag. Please put the bread in that one.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the bread to be put in the small cloth bag you brought. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: パンは布の袋に分けますね。お支払いはどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll put the bread separately in the cloth bag. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現金で払います。先にポイントの画面を見せたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金払いを選びポイント画面を出す順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll pay cash. Should I show you the points screen first?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose cash payment and ask when to show the points screen. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この練習用レジでは、お会計前に画面を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: At this practice checkout, we check the screen before taking payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 画面が暗くなりました。開き直すまで少し待ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 消えた画面を開き直す間待ってほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The screen has gone dark. Could you wait a moment while I open it again?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to wait while you reopen the screen that went dark. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お待ちしますので、慌てずに操作してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll wait, so take your time operating it.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示できました。会計が終わったら、野菜の袋は自分で運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面を提示して野菜の袋を自分で運ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's showing now. Once I've paid, I'll carry the bag of vegetables myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the screen and say that you will carry the vegetable bag yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: パンは布の袋に入れました。袋の底を支えてお持ちください。またお買い物にいらしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've put the bread in the cloth bag. Please support the bottom of the bag as you carry it. We hope you'll shop with us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その傘について、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened with that umbrella?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき買ったのですが、留め具が外れなくて開けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入直後の傘が開かないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I just bought it, but I can't release the fastener, so I can't open it.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the umbrella you just bought will not open. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認してもよろしいですか。レシートもあれば拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I check it? If you have the receipt, I'd like to see that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらがレシートです。壊しそうで、強く引っ張ってはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートを示し無理な操作をしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the receipt. I haven't pulled hard because I was afraid of breaking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and say that you have not forced it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここに包装の留め具が残っています。外したあとで動きを確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's still a packaging fastener here. I'll remove it and then check how it moves.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 包装だったんですね。持ち手のボタンも押すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包装と持ち手ボタンの使い方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it was part of the packaging. Do I also press the button on the handle?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check about the packaging and how to use the handle button. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ボタンの使い方は、この説明書を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's look at these instructions together to see how to use the button.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店の中で開くと危ないので、空いた場所で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人にぶつからない空いた場所で試したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opening it inside the shop would be dangerous, so I'd like to check it in a clear space.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to try it in a clear space where it won't hit anyone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 人がいないことを確かめてから、入口脇の確認場所をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking that nobody is there, please use the testing area beside the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこでゆっくり試します。動かなければ、またこのレシートを持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試しても動かなければレシートを持って戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll try it slowly there. If it doesn't work, I'll bring this receipt back again.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that if it still doesn't work when you try it, you will return with the receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 説明書もお持ちください。帰り道は傘の先に気をつけて、またお困りの際はお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the instructions too. Watch the tip of the umbrella on your way home, and let us know if you need help again.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 一覧のどの項目をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which item on the list are you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越してきたので手続きをしたいのですが、この二つの名前が似ていて迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た手続き名で行き先を迷っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved here and want to complete the procedures, but these two names are similar, so I wasn't sure where to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that similar procedure names have left you unsure where to go. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所に関する手続きと、別の申請の窓口ですね。今日は何を持参されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Those are the desk for address-related procedures and the desk for a different application. What have you brought today?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引っ越しのときにもらった書類を持っています。まずどこで内容を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参書類の内容を最初に見てもらえる場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the documents I received when I moved. Where can I first have someone look at what's in them?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where someone can first check the documents you brought. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内担当が書類の種類を確認します。個人情報の部分はこちらへ向けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The information staff will check the types of documents. Please turn the parts with personal information toward us.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 全部を机に広げず、必要なものだけ出せばいいんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要な書類だけ出せばよいか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I should just take out what's needed, rather than spread everything over the desk?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether you should take out only the necessary documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ええ。確認後に担当窓口へご案内しますので、今は番号札を取らずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We'll direct you to the responsible desk after checking, so please wait without taking a queue ticket yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に番号を取るところでした。別の申請も今日相談したいと伝えていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号札をまだ取らず別の申請も相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was about to take a number first. May I also say that I want to discuss the other application today?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not take a queue ticket yet and also want to discuss another application. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も伺います。ただし今日すべて終えられるかは各窓口で確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll hear that request too. However, each desk needs to confirm whether everything can be completed today.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 窓口ごとに確認が必要なのですね。住所の手続きを先に確認して、残った申請の行き先をメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所の手続きを先に確認し残りの行き先を記録すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: So I need to check with each desk. I'll check the address procedure first, then note where to go for the remaining application.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the address procedure first and note where to go for the rest. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 順番を整理して進めましょう。案内担当へおつなぎしますので、書類を手元にまとめてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's sort out the order and proceed. I'll put you in touch with the information staff, so gather your documents and take them with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの紙は不在票ですね。どなた宛てでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: The paper you have is a missed-delivery notice. Who is it addressed to?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ家に住む姉宛てです。私が来たのですが、受け取れるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票が同居する姉宛てで代理受取の可否を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for my older sister, who lives in the same house. I've come instead, and I want to check whether I can collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the missed-delivery notice is for your older sister who lives with you, and ask whether you may collect it for her. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物の種類によって確認が異なります。まず票を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The checks differ depending on the type of parcel. May I see the notice first?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どうぞ。姉は今日は来られませんが、電話なら話せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 票を渡して姉は来られないが電話対応は可能と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here you are. My sister can't come today, but she can talk on the phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hand over the notice and say that your sister cannot come but can speak on the phone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の段階では受け取り可能とはお約束できません。担当者に票を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: At this stage, I can't promise that you can collect it. I'll have the staff member check the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け取りに必要なものと、本人が申し込む方法を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代理受取の持ち物と本人の申込方法を別々に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please explain separately what I need to bring to collect it for her and how she can make a request herself.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask separately what to bring for collection on someone else's behalf and how the addressee can apply herself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二点を確認します。今日は荷物を急いで使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check those two points. Do you need to use the parcel urgently today?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 急ぎではありません。姉が帰宅する日に届けてもらう方法も考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急ぎではなく姉の帰宅日に再配達したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's not urgent. I'd also like to consider having it delivered on a day when my sister will be home.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is not urgent and discuss redelivery on a day your sister will be home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再配達の受付方法と指定できる条件も担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will also explain how to request redelivery and the conditions for specifying it.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 姉に確認結果を伝えて、本人から申し込むかどうか決めてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した結果を姉に伝えて申込方法を本人に決めてもらうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my sister what you confirm and let her decide whether to request it herself.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your sister the results and let her decide how to apply. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では不在票をなくさずにお持ちください。お姉様と相談してから、案内された方法でお手続きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the missed-delivery notice safe. After discussing it with your sister, complete the procedure using the method explained to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードのことでお困りとのことですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're having a problem with your card, I understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布が見つかりません。銀行のカードも入っていたので、利用を止める相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布とカードの所在不明を説明して利用停止を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find my wallet. My bank card was in it too, so I'd like to discuss stopping its use.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your wallet and card are missing and discuss blocking the card. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 手続き担当へおつなぎします。カード番号を覚えていなくても、その旨をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll connect you with the staff member who handles that procedure. Even if you don't remember the card number, please tell them so.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号はわかりません。名前や連絡先は、ここで声に出して言うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号不明を伝え周囲のいる場所で情報を言うべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't know the number. Am I supposed to say my name and contact details out loud here?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know the number and ask whether to state your information where other people are present. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周囲に聞こえない方法で確認します。こちらの相談席へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll verify it in a way that people nearby can't overhear. Please come to this consultation seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かります。止めたあとに財布が見つかった場合の扱いも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 停止後に財布が見つかった場合の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you, that helps. I'd also like to ask what happens if I find my wallet after the card is blocked.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what happens if your wallet is found after the card is blocked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 再利用できるかどうかは、停止方法などを担当者が確認してご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check and explain whether it can be used again, depending on how it was blocked and other factors.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 再発行を今すぐ決める前に、その違いをメモしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再発行を決める前に対応の違いを書いてもらうよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before I decide right away to get a replacement, could you write down the differences in how each case is handled?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to write down the differences in the responses before you decide on reissuance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者へそのご希望を伝えます。ほかに気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that request on to the staff member. Is there anything else you're concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社からの振り込みへの影響も確認したいので、相談項目に加えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社の振り込みへの影響も相談項目に加える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I also want to check the effect on transfers from my employer, so please add that to the consultation topics.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add the effect on transfers from your employer to the consultation topics. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三つの確認事項を引き継ぎます。相談席で担当者をお待ちください。財布も無事に見つかるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on the three points to check. Please wait for the staff member at the consultation seat. I hope your wallet turns up safely too.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご利用前に確認しておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to check before using the facility?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分のタオルを持ってきました。浴室ではどこに置けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参タオルを浴室でどこに置くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought my own towel. Where should I put it in the bathing area?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to put the towel you brought in the bathing area. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習施設では、浴槽に入れず手元で管理していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this practice facility, we ask you to keep it with you and not put it in the bath.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 湯の中に落とさないようにします。眼鏡はどうすればいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: タオルを湯に入れないと確認し眼鏡の管理を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll make sure not to drop it in the bathwater. What should I do with my glasses?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will keep the towel out of the bathwater, and ask about looking after your glasses. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 置き場所の案内はこちらですが、破損が心配なら持ち込む前にご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The storage guidance is here, but if you're worried about damage, please consider that before bringing them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内が見えにくくなるので、浴室へ入る前に順番を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見えにくくなる前に利用順序を教えてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The signs will become hard for me to see, so could you explain the order of use before I enter the bathing area?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to be told the order of use before it becomes hard for you to see. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まずこちらの掲示を一緒に確認しましょう。わからない表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, let's check this notice together. Are there any signs you don't understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この「かけ湯」という言葉の意味がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 掲示のかけ湯という言葉の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't understand what the word 'kakeyu' here means.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what the word 'kakeyu' on the notice means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 浴槽へ入る前に体へお湯をかけることです。使い方は浴室の表示でも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It means pouring hot water over your body before entering the bath. Please also check the signs in the bathing area for how to use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 言葉の意味がわかりました。荷物をしまってから、表示を見て利用します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明を理解し荷物を収納して表示に従うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the word now. I'll put my belongings away, then use the facility according to the signs.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you understand the explanation and will store your belongings and follow the signs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 足元が濡れていることもありますので、ゆっくりお進みください。どうぞごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The floor may be wet, so please move slowly. Take your time and enjoy your stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのように見学なさる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: How are you planning to look around today?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父と来ました。長く歩くと疲れるので、途中で戻れる道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父が疲れやすく途中で引き返す道を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came with my father. He gets tired if he walks for a long time, so I'd like to know routes where we can turn back partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your father tires easily and you want to know a route for turning back along the way. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内図を使って、今いる場所と戻る道を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's use this map to check where you are now and the route back.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 階段の多い道を避けたいのですが、図の点線は何を表していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段を避けたい希望と点線の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: We'd like to avoid routes with lots of stairs. What do the dotted lines on the map represent?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to avoid stairs and ask what the dotted lines mean. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図の凡例をご覧ください。実際に通れるかは現地の案内でも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look at the legend on this map. You'll also need to check the signs on site to see whether you can actually pass through.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 点線だけで判断してはいけないんですね。休んでから続きを決められる場所も探せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行可否を現地でも確認し休憩して判断できる場所を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: So we shouldn't judge by the dotted lines alone. Can we also look for somewhere to rest and then decide whether to continue?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check accessibility on site too and look for a place to rest before deciding whether to continue. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図に示された休憩地点を確認しましょう。見学の終わりには予定がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the rest points shown on the map. Do you have any plans after your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 夕方に友人と会いますが、急いで全部を見るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 夕方の予定はあるが全体を急いで見ないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: We're meeting a friend in the evening, but we don't intend to rush to see everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have evening plans but will not rush through the whole site. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら、ここでお父様の様子を見て先へ進むか戻るかを決めてはいかがでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then why not assess how your father is feeling here and decide whether to go on or turn back?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この地点を目安にします。帰りの道も図に印をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 判断地点を決めて戻る道を図に印してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll use this point as our reference. Please mark the way back on the map too.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a decision point and ask for the return route to be marked on the map. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 帰路の印をつけました。現地の表示にも気を配って、無理のない見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've marked the route back. Pay attention to the signs on site too, and enjoy looking around without overexerting yourselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 参拝の場所と御朱印の受付、どちらをご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions to the worship area or the reception for temple and shrine seals?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 御朱印をお願いしたいのですが、先に受付に並ぶのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 御朱印を依頼する前に列へ並ぶべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to request a seal. Should I join the reception queue first?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to join the queue before requesting a temple or shrine seal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず参拝なさるのでしたら、参拝の場所を案内します。受付の状況は別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you'd like to worship first, I'll show you the worship area. Let's check the reception situation separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 参拝もしたいです。こちらの列は何を待つ列ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参拝希望を伝えて目の前の列が何の列か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to worship too. What are the people in this queue waiting for?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to worship and ask what the queue in front of you is for. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この学習場面では、別の案内を待つ列です。受付の掲示を一緒に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this learning scenario, they're waiting for other guidance. Please look at the reception notice with me.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 列が違うんですね。御朱印帳を持っていない場合も相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 御朱印帳を持たず受付に相談できるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it's a different queue. Can I ask at reception even if I don't have a seal book?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether you can consult reception without a temple or shrine seal book. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対応の有無は受付の担当者にお尋ねください。ここで確約はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the reception staff whether they can accommodate that. I can't promise it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付で聞いてみます。参拝中は写真を撮らず、撮れる場所をあとで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 参拝中は撮影せず撮影可能な場所を後で確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask at reception. I won't take photos while worshipping, and I'll check later where photos are allowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not take photos while worshipping and will check allowed photography locations afterward. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 周りの方の参拝を妨げないようにしていただければ助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'd appreciate it if you avoid disturbing other people's worship.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず参拝してから、掲示を見て受付の方に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参拝後に掲示を読み受付担当者へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll worship first, then read the notice and consult the reception staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the notice and consult reception after worshipping. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ順にお進みください。境内では足元にも気をつけて、穏やかな時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed in that order. Watch your step on the temple or shrine grounds, and enjoy a peaceful time.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談にいらしたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've come for a consultation, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない人から何度も連絡が来ます。ここで詳しく話してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 繰り返す知らない相手の連絡について詳しく話せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone I don't know keeps contacting me. Can I talk about it in detail here?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can discuss repeated contact from an unknown person in detail. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 周囲に聞かれたくない内容でしたら、担当者に相談場所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: If it's something you don't want people nearby to hear, I'll check with the staff member about a consultation space.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 個人のことなので、別の場所で話したいです。予約が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の場所で話したい希望と予約の要否を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's personal, so I'd like to talk somewhere else. Do I need an appointment?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to talk in a different place and ask whether an appointment is necessary. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の方法は担当者に確認します。今すぐ身の安全に関わる状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the staff member about the reception process. Is your physical safety at immediate risk?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は安全な場所にいます。届いたメッセージはスマートフォンに残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今は安全でメッセージを端末に保存していると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm in a safe place now. I've kept the messages I received on my smartphone.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you are safe now and have saved the messages on your device. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 削除する前に担当者へ見せたいということですね。時刻や内容がわかるように準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: You'd like to show them to the staff member before deleting them. Please have them ready so the times and content can be seen.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 画面を勝手に公開せず、相談する人だけに見せるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面を公開せず相談担当者だけに見せると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll make sure not to publish the screens on my own and only show them to the person I consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not make the screens public and will show them only to the consultation staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それで結構です。相談時に説明したいことを整理できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's fine. Can you organize what you'd like to explain during the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最初に連絡が来た日と回数をメモして、受付方法を確認してから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 初回の日と回数を記録して受付方法を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the date of the first contact and the number of times, then check the reception procedure before consulting someone.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the date of the first contact and the number of contacts and check the reception procedure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのメモを担当者にお渡しください。状況が変わった場合は安全な場所からお知らせください。今日はお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give that note to the staff member. If the situation changes, let us know from a safe place. Please take care on your way home today.
